claims.summary: Production source-ledger filtering preserves canonical OpenStax Python OER rows for ambiguous CS concepts.
Committed source-ledger and deep-grader regressions keep real Python false-friend source rows failing instead of hiding them.
The deep quality grader mirrors the same canonical OpenStax Python OER rule as production source-ledger filtering.
The release ledger explicitly preserves the need for a fresh funded ZIP/log audit before claiming clean model output.

knownRemainingTargets: A fresh deployed v0.15.158 provider ZIP/log audit must prove real output source rows are canonical, linked, licensed, and on-topic.
A same-version GPT-5.4-mini versus GPT-5.5-pro comparison is still needed before attributing remaining losses to model choice.
Existing ZIP2 still contains real false-friend rows and should not be treated as clean evidence.
Every fresh audit still has to reconcile UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, and local regrade before claiming clean output.
